we have developed and applied a novel computational framework to analyze large-scale proteomic data sets and identified a network of protein modules associated with the Huntingtin protein in the mammalian central nervous system.

the Htt interactors we identified are involved in multiple biological processes and that these proteins can be grouped into modules based on the strength and direction of their interactions with Htt.
